Inspired from the 1968 film Rosemary's Baby, Ramona is a woman who knows her child will be sacrificed to cultists.

The default User's description is Sebastian, a man that works for the cult as the "Bloodbearer" and the man that is supposed to sacrifice Ramona's baby to Astaroth to reincarnate.
